findings.title: Require collected execution coverage for every declared selector
findings.body: At the reviewed SHA, m3_execution_evidence_errors only proves each nodeid belongs to any selector. The exact legacy DB regression command names tests/db/test_migrations.py and tests/db/test_transaction_interfaces.py, but a collection/stdout/JUnit record containing only a migrations case is accepted with no errors. This omits the transaction-interface regression while representing the whole required command as PASS. M3_CLOSURE_CONTRACT requires selectors cannot be omitted. Require every declared selector to contribute collected and executed cases and add a negative regression.

findings.title: Reject noninteger execution and collection exit codes
findings.body: The contract requires an integer zero exit code. Execution and collection checks use numeric equality to zero and reject bool only; JSON 0.0 therefore passes both checks. The immutable-source bounded probes accept float execution and float collection exit codes with no errors. Enforce exact integer type and zero for both records, with negative regression tests.
